claims.title: Directed Euler tours: pointwise lift control, finite-bit costs and exact BEST projection

quoted_fields.interface: Strongly connected directed Eulerian multigraphs with distinguished parallel/loop arcs and a fixed first labelled arc rooted at its tail. The prospective full sampler must control ENTIRE-tour TV and every-run complete BIT work/memory/randomness near input/output-linear up to polylogs; that full target is unfinished. Pointwise lift hypotheses and fixed finite walk length are explicit conditional contracts.
quoted_fields.failure: Imported skew-determinantal mixing and pointwise permutation-gadget results are credited at the root-read version, not new Capital proofs or world-best/novelty claims. The constant-fibre/TV/finite-bit compositions are completed scoped interfaces; no full nearlinear backend or general lower bound is proved. Minimum-cost arborescence optimization is not sampling. A 2021 parallel arborescence result was seen only at record/abstract scope and no unread work-bound theorem is imported. All source/access/transfer holds and native-memory limits persist.
